description: Submit your answers to the project's discovery questions, answered in your own AI session, so they roll up into the shared brief attributed to you. Answer in your own words — PAPI stores what you wrote and never generates questions itself. Submitting again replaces your previous answers rather than adding a second copy. Use this after `join` when you have answers to contribute.

answers.description: Your answers, in your own words. Free text — the questions came from wherever your group agreed them.

member_name.description: How to attribute these answers in the shared brief (your name, so teammates can see who said what). Defaults to the connected account.

name: discovery_intake
